description: The plot illustrates the relationship between a value on the x-axis and a BLEU score. The x-axis is labeled “”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0.0 to 10.0, and has tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU”, has a linear scale, ranges from 18.0 to 28.0, and has tick labels at intervals of 2.0. A red line, marked with star-shaped data points, begins at approximately (0.0, 22.0) and increases to (10.0, 27.5), with a peak at (7.5, 27.8). A purple line, marked with circle-shaped data points, begins at approximately (0.0, 20.5) and increases to (10.0, 26.5). A blue, dashed line, marked with square-shaped data points, begins at approximately (0.0, 18.0) and increases to (10.0, 26.0).
